description: Testnet behavioral guarantee: every field is committed by SHA-256 of canonical JSON.

schema_version.description: Selects exact validation and adjudication semantics.

chain_id.description: Prevents signing or funding on mainnet.

promisor.description: Identifies whose test coins are locked and returned on pass.

beneficiary.description: Fixes the recipient of compensation on failure.

patch.description: Pins the actual delivered binary instead of a mutable version label.

artifact.description: Locates the binary; the CLI supplies the local mirror, checked by hash.

sha256.description: Detects replacement or mutation of the promised patch artifact.

spring_boot.description: Defines the upgraded runtime covered by this guarantee.

replays.description: Enumerates the covered catalog drift IDs; uncovered drifts carry no guarantee.

items.description: One executable clause with its acceptance oracle.

drift_id.description: Links to the existing 12-rule catalog, without implying all rules were replayed.

command.description: Records exact application argv; interpreter only accepts this allowlisted command, never a shell.

request.description: Pins the HTTP method and path under test.

normalization.description: Excludes only Spring error timestamp; hashes canonical status/body JSON.

expected_output_sha256.description: Makes acceptance a byte-level comparison against measured baseline, not human discretion.

amount_wei.description: Avoids floating point rounding and prevents a zero-value guarantee.

currency.description: Names the testnet native currency, never real ETH.

oracle.description: Makes the off-chain trust boundary explicit.

kind.description: Current version trusts a named runner; this is not a proof of Java execution.

address.description: Only this signer may post harness verdict and evidence hash.

runner_sha256.description: Pins the adjudicator implementation used for replay.

evidence_commitment.description: Records the full canonical evidence SHA-256 in the Reported and Settled events.

relay_validation.description: Existing live relay has no bond verbs; no fictional relay verification is claimed.

starts_at.description: Bounds when covered failures may be submitted.

expires_at.description: Pass replay happens after this Unix timestamp; end must follow start.

release_condition.description: Locks the acceptance predicate and earliest release.

slash_condition.description: Defines compensable behavioral or artifact mismatch; infrastructure failures block.

dispute.description: States what a challenge window actually permits.

seconds.description: Minimum delay after an oracle report before anyone can settle.

policy.description: Failure supersedes pass and cannot be erased; no human arbitration.

unavailable_oracle.description: No-result is not a pass or fail; funds remain locked.
